description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A circular woven serving platform with a low perimeter lip. Side: A shallow solid bamboo turntable pedestal supports the flat top. Rear: The rear continues the woven rim above a plain rotating bearing base. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
